cards.name: The Nine Personas Unseen
cards.text: Target 1 face-up monster; you can add up to 1 Level 1 Monster or a Spell/Trap that mentions a Level 1 Monster from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Effect Veiler
cards.text: During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Dark Hole
cards.text: Destroy all monsters on the field.

cards.name: Snatch Steal
cards.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target.
